caption_prefix: Watch KreekCraft on YouTube and Twitch!
campaign_focus: KreekCraft's own reactions and personality in GTA 6: him laughing, screaming, getting scared, raging, or reacting to something unexpected; wild police chases, explosions and ridiculous encounters; funny fails; unexpected discoveries in Vice City. The first 1-2 seconds must hook. Titles and captions must describe exactly what happened: no misleading clickbait, no invented context. Captions must not contain links or URLs. Skip giveaway reading, sponsor segments, AFK or quiet driving.
